newsitem.title: GERMANY: German call money eases to 3.02/03 percent.
newsitem.headline: German call money eases to 3.02/03 percent.

text.p: German call money rates eased to 3.02/3.03 percent on Tuesday from 3.05 percent on Monday afternoon but dealers said rates may firm slightly during the day as commercial bank deposits at the central bank had fallen.
Dealers predicted the Bundesbank may drain some funds from the market in its repo allocation on Wednesdays when repos totalling 62.2 billion marks expire.
Commercial banks' deposits at the central bank fell to 37.8 billion marks on Monday from 38.5 billion on Friday while the monthly average fell to 40.4 billion marks from 40.8 billion.
Lombard borrowings were negligible on Monday.
The Frankfurt Interbank Overnight Average was 3.05500 percent on Tuesday compared with 3.05267 percent on Monday.
